notes.title: Inside Blockremental #1
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,  [/p][p]We thought it would be a good time to give you a glimpse of what Blockremental actually feels like to play. So we’ve put together a short video that shows the first few minutes of gameplay. A quick dive into the atmosphere, the flow, and how the adventure begins. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, we’ve also been running a few experiments behind the scenes. Some of the things we’ve been playing around with include:  [/p][p][/p][p]🌍 A larger world, to give exploration even more room to breathe. [/p][p] 🏜️🏔️ New biomes, like desert and mountain, to break up the scenery.[/p][p]  🌋 An underground lava cave, which might just end up being home to a pretty big threat…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p]  These are still very much in the testing phase, but we thought it’d be fun to share a peek at what’s cooking.  Thanks so much for following the project. Your feedback and support really keep us going 🙌 And don't hesitate to join [url="https://discord.gg/nunvFZ3scf"]our Discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Update v0.1.1a
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ Patch Note v0.1.1a[/h1][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who took the time to try out the [i]Blockremental[/i] demo, dig tunnels, fight off waves of golems… and share their feedback! Your comments have been incredibly helpful in refining the gameplay, squashing bugs, and improving the overall experience.[/p][p]This first patch is a solid one: we’ve added content, rebalanced systems, optimized performance, improved the interface… and even tweaked the lighting, because seeing clearly while digging matters.[/p][p]One big swing of the pickaxe later, and here are the changes![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][h2]📦 Freshly Mined Additions[/h2][list][*][p][b]Wooden Construction Cube[/b]  
Now available from Layer 1. Smells like fresh forest![/p][/*][*][p][b]Cube Exchange System[/b]  
Trade in your old blocks for shiny new ones![/p][/*][*][p][b]Guide Improvements[/b]  
Info bubbles now appear right before your very eyes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tooltips Added[/b]  
Hover over a craft with your mouse to learn more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Blocks: Concrete and Steel[/b]  
For bases that look as tough as they are.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img] [/p][h2]🔧 Performance and Polish[/h2][list][*][p][b]FSR / Sharpen / FrameGen[/b]  
If you know what this means, great. If not: more FPS for everyone![/p][/*][*][p][b]GameThread Optimization[/b]  
We mopped up performance issues like pros.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Accessibility[/b]  
Mouse axis inversion, visible cursor, color options: everything to ensure everyone plays in comfort.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlockable Layer Cap Raised to 16[/b]  
Dig deeper than before (previously capped at 10).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Anti-Clipping System[/b]  
No more falling into the void like a cursed pixel. You’ll now be teleported to a safe zone automatically![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img] [/p][h2]⚔️ Balancing (or at least an attempt...)[/h2][list][*][p][b]Defense Machines[/b]  
Damage values adjusted. Yes, again.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breaker Machines[/b]  
Same deal. Still refining things with a chisel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progression & Recipes[/b]  
Major overhaul: core gameplay reviewed from the ground up. Your feedback is welcome![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img]   [/p][h2]🖥️ Interface & HUD[/h2][list][*][p][b]Redesigned HUD[/b]  
More visible slots, clearer selection, and an easier-to-read warning bar for incoming golem waves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved 7x7 Platform[/b]  
Now includes colored indicators for better clarity at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reward Interface Updated[/b]  
Clearer than ever: now you’ll know exactly what you’re gaining (or missing).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img] [/p][h2]🧟 Golems & Waves[/h2][list][*][p][b]Improved AI[/b]  
Golem movement and speed have been slightly reduced for better pacing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Golem Waves[/b]  
The first wave now starts at Layer 4. The deeper you go, the tougher it gets: more health, speed, and damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Conductivity[/b]  
All iron and copper blocks are now conductive. Ugly cables are out, stylish and functional builds are in. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img]  [/p][h2]🔦 Lighting & Weapons[/h2][list][*][p][b]Torches[/b]  
Lighting has been adjusted for better ambience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]MegaLamp[/b]  
Lights up the area like it's daytime.[/p][/*][*][p][b]WirelessLamp[/b]  
Increased range and brightness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]IronAxe[/i] – Fast golem-slicing action, perfect for late-game.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Iron Mass[/i] – Smashes through EVERYTHING in its path. Yes, EVERYTHING. 💥[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img]   [/p][h2]🎵 Sound & Atmosphere[/h2][list][*][p][b]Music, SFX, ambient sounds[/b]  
Now deeper, richer, and more immersive. We added a little oil to your ears.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for this first chunky patch. Keep digging, keep testing, keep smashing things—and please keep sharing your feedback! [/p][p][i]We’ll keep coding while you keep clobbering golems.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Blockremental is available in the Steam Neo Fest
notes.content:
[p]Hello Children of Mikia,[/p][p][/p][p]🧱 Blockremental joins the Steam Neo Fest today with the release of its very first playable demo![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/9261c49615aa32564c2ba6294e48df66cb6ed583.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s an important milestone for us: you can now experience the game’s early mechanics, feel its pacing, its gameplay loop… and hopefully walk away with just as much curiosity as we had while developing it.[/p][p]In Blockremental, you take control of a platform left behind by the goddess Mikia, capable of drilling through the many layers of a mysterious island.[/p][p]Your mission: descend.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]But this is no ordinary underground world. An ancient Dragon, sealed deep beneath the surface, has been watching for centuries… and now sends its golems to slow you down.[/p][p]It’s up to you to build, automate, defend your base, and find a way to keep going, even as the pressure grows stronger with each new level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/712074f9d091a9005f43447287d7d9c24df7cd7e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Blockremental is a solo project developed by Benja, a member of the iolaCorp team. It’s powered by BoxelScape, our in-house plugin built to create large-scale, dynamic, cube-based worlds in Unreal Engine.[/p][p]It also marks the first entry in Beldia, an original universe in the making — one that will eventually host multiple stories, games, and experiences.[/p][p]This demo is your very first gateway.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/2d712ec94219e334945368c87ada9941c3d1c769.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who takes the time to try it out. Your feedback will be incredibly valuable, whether it’s about gameplay, tech, or just how the game [i]feels[/i] to you.[/p][p][/p][p][i]See you soon in the depths of Beldia. 
The Blockremental Team[/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Game Guide
notes.content: [p]Welcome to Blockremental![/p][p]In this cubical excavation game, you play as a young hero determined to uncover the island’s secrets... and confront the dragon Nefarok.[/p][p]Blockremental blends several familiar genres: incremental progression, tower defense, crafting, wave survival, and scoring, all combined into a unique and accessible experience.[/p][p]Here’s a guide to help you start your adventure on the right foot.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Awakening[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]You open your eyes on a mysterious island. In front of you stands the central platform: the core of your progression and the only way to reach the depths where Nefarok sleeps.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/0d920b96a1359cb0f584f9a81e0f482cb2670b0c.png"][/img][/p][p]This strange structure is not just a machine. It’s an ancient artifact left behind by Mikia, the vanished goddess, to guide her descendant (you!) on a sacred mission. The platform is your lifeline, your gateway to the underground, and the only thing capable of drilling through the layers of the island to uncover its darkest secrets.[/p][p]To begin, activate the platform by pressing F. This will trigger the appearance of your first block, drawn directly from the layer below.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/71a4f07c9abd26895a8fc1ee257b40360383beb8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Punch the block with your bare hands to start breaking it. Each block has a resistance gauge that appears as you strike it. Some blocks will be harder and take longer to destroy than others. Once the block is broken, another one appears in its place, continuing the descent.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/8120fcea6eb2bb04b7814e40166d13cd4c3cd96d.gif"][/img][/p][p]A red beam of light above the platform marks the exact spot where the block has been taken from, allowing you to track how deep you’ve gone into the current layer.[/p][p]Tip: You can press E to sit on the platform’s seat. While seated and aiming the little square on the block, it will be broken automatically over time, letting you focus on other tasks or simply observe... though at a slower pace.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/a9a651bd0ffb7505799aa4e71adddecd7a975db8.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]First tools and resources[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Take a moment to explore your surroundings and gather some basic materials:[/p][list][*][p]Wood can be collected by chopping down trees with your bare hands.[/p][/*][*][p]Stone can be found in the environment or obtained by breaking blocks on the platform.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/c393cfe8d32dde7c9c4c719179b1db87fd38d50a.png"][/img][/p][p]As you progress, you’ll also discover rarer resources scattered throughout the world.[/p][p]With your early materials, you’ll be able to craft your first tools:  The Mass, which lets you deal heavier blows, and the Axe, which cuts down trees more efficiently.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/2975df0ea77ef5fb3156afde2388b3f14b9059e4.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ll also gain access to the Ultimate Breaker, a special power granted by Mikia that allows you to instantly destroy a block in one hit. But use it wisely, it has limited charges![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]The platform and its interface[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]On the left side of your screen, you’ll find the interface showing key information:[/p][list][*][p]Your current level progress[/p][/*][*][p]Your experience level (XP)[/p][/*][*][p]The damage rate inflicted on blocks[/p][/*][*][p]The respawn time for new blocks[/p][/*][*][p]The crafting time for items[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/0fbc7c8637feb56608e74184a83cb42d38f14466.png"][/img][/p][p]Keeping an eye on these values will help you make the most of your time and optimize your workflow.[/p][p]Every time you reach a new layer, you’ll unlock fresh crafting recipes. After each layer, you’ll be presented with two additional recipes, pick one to specialize your playstyle and customize your build.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Talent trees[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]As you dig deeper, you’ll unlock two separate talent trees.[/p][p]The first one is focused on your character. It allows you to improve your health, resistance, movement speed, and unlock abilities like double jump.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/4e0470fec4ba19a3c3de1b13b423cce064f020df.png"][/img][/p][p]The second one enhances your platform. It lets you increase the number of machines you can place, speed up the auto-click rate, and improve rewards like XP, Gold, and loot bonuses.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/5546a673cd334610bca8e598761fc81ebfe8f459.png"][/img]  [/p][p]To unlock talents, you’ll need to spend the Gold you earn from mining. Choose your upgrades carefully to shape your strategy and boost your efficiency as you descend further.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]The golems[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Nefarok won’t sit idly by. As you dig deeper, he will send waves of golems to stop your progress. These enemies become more aggressive as you reach lower layers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/85b0935bc916c4ce8e3bc43d9fa68546d466745f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Some golems are flying units, hovering above your platform and sometimes harder to hit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/3b9c64c08b1919ec90e23b89e2f0d30b8b0674ef.gif"][/img][/p][p]But don’t panic. Your tools, especially the Axe, have a specific reach distance. This value is displayed in the interface (for example: "+3 meters") and allows you to strike airborne enemies without needing to jump.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/955a6889c421f6ee4e38cd42ac609dd99db11635.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]First machines and Energies[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Once the recipe becomes available, you’ll be able to craft your very first machine: the PafferBreaker.  It allows you to mine blocks on the platform automatically.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/a349a8d655bdfbf40fd9670849ca5c6ef2629b64.png"][/img][/p][p]Machines won’t work on their ownn, they need energy to run. That’s where your power system comes into play.[/p][p]At the heart of your setup lies the Generator, installed near your central platform.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/c1eb9bf96f2d16d9c12d3dbb82ad300bd682a0f2.png"][/img][/p][p]But it won’t work right away: to activate it, you’ll need to attach a Power Node. Simply place it directly above or below the Generator. Then activate it by getting into the Generator control panel (press F) and click on Top or Down (depending where you have installed the Power Node).[/p][p]You can check if the Power Node is active at the bottom (one Node should be green).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/2cd4980762885cb2dc555733a828cd095eb4be6d.png"][/img][/p][p]🔸 Where to find the Power Node?[/p][p]You’ll unlock it once you reach the layer 2 of the island. Place it above or below the ForgeCore to supply it with energy.[/p][p]Once powered, your next step is to distribute that energy. To do this, you’ll need to craft a Power Hub (2 Iron + 2 Copper). This Hub must be physically connected to the Generator to relay the energy to nearby machines. You can also use Connectors (available on Layer 4) to create a more complex circuit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/9f028d5b8f719db358037e86b0f9e0eac501f5ff.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Without Connector[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/31b43e9593ca44f7b20eeb2c3c035ad2aef31ea5.png"][/img][/p][p][i]With Connectors[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/e25bade6fb58f5d874419c70676c0ae7caad2e5e.png"][/img][/p][p]When the setup is complete, a glowing energy dome will appear, showing the range of your power system. Any machine inside this dome will automatically receive the energy it needs to function.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/4fb0d75b1fe2fa83cdd091c10d8a8699f94221c1.png"][/img] [/p][p]Tip: Make sure your machines are placed within the dome. If they’re outside, they won’t receive power![/p][p]Tip 2: Beware of the Golems! They'll try to destroy your installations![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/fc19fb73d89b4c45b91665c52d7d28f25ff8e3ae.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]What’s next?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Now that you know the basics, your mission is clear: keep digging, expand your setup with new machines, defend yourself from golem waves, and uncover the ancient secrets buried beneath the island.[/p][p]Each expedition you undertake is also what we call a score run. Once Nefarok is defeated, you’ll be shown a detailed summary of your performance: total time, blocks broken, gold collected, enemies defeated, and more.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477005/f336c35a9c56799de0fc3a24736da7e42ea0a898.png"][/img][/p][p]Your final score gives you a way to measure your efficiency and improve on your next run. Try new strategies, adjust your build, and challenge yourself to go deeper, faster, and smarter.[/p]
